== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the Premiere [[Gold 1]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label. Use Show changes before saving, then check both the new article and existing family members. The current article highlights automatically.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/Gold 1 (Premiere)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity. Era and set headings are linked, bold and underlined; publication entries use normal links.

Set 1 article titles follow the approved #384 scheme: Original unnumbered, Numbered, Premium, Remastered (2006). [[Gold 1 (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)]] redirects to the Remastered (2006) article.

[[Gold 1 (persona)]] is not a publication in this family.
